LAW AND MOTION, 301, DEFENDANTS BOLDWATER MANAGEMENT LP AND BOLDWATER CAPITAL MANAGEMENT LLC'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS FOR LACK OF PERSONAL JURISDICTION IS DENIED. DEFENDANTS ENTERED INTO A CONTRACT TO PURCHASE SOFTWARE AND SERVICES FROM A PLAINTIFF LOCATED IN CALIFORNIA KNOWING THAT PLAINTIFF WAS LOCATED HERE AND AGREEING TO SEND PAYMENTS TO CALIFORNIA OVER A PERIOD OF YEARS AND TO BE BOUND BY CALIFORNIA IN THE EVENT OF A DISPUTE. THE CONSEQUENCES OF DEFENDANT'S ALLEGED FAILURE TO PAY ARE FELT IN CALIFORNIA AND DEFENDANT HAS SUFFICIENTLY AVAILED ITSELF OF THE PROTECTIONS OF CALIFORNIA LAW THAT IT COULD FORESEE BEING HAILED INTO A CALIFORNIA COURT. THEREFORE, THIS COURT CAN EXERCISE SPECIFIC JURISDICTION OVER THIS DEFENDANT. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
